company: Coffee Day Enterprises Ltd. / Café Coffee Day
known_facts_at_decision_date: Coffee Day Enterprises and Café Coffee Day were founder-led under V.G. Siddhartha
V.G. Siddhartha died in late July 2019 — a sudden founder and key-person crisis
The company was carrying very high debt, reported at approximately ₹70 billion (₹7,000 crore) in 2019
Coffee Day group operated a large retail café network and multiple diversified business interests
The crisis combined: debt pressure, sudden key-person dependency collapse, governance and reputational shock, creditor confidence risk, and the need for asset monetization
The underlying business challenge was not simply low sales but survival: creditor confidence, leadership continuity, asset sale decisions, and brand preservation while reducing debt
Multiple lenders and creditors had exposure to Coffee Day group entities

question: Following the sudden death of founder V.G. Siddhartha amid approximately ₹70 billion in debt, creditor pressure, and a large multi-business group structure, diagnose root causes and recommend the highest-priority action plan to stabilize the business and begin debt reduction.
